sourceGeneratorRootCause.observation: The generator collects declarations in an ImmutableHashSet and orders emitted types by namespace plus inner type name, omitting enclosing type. Two Bootstrap.Log types can swap output order, changing the PDB document and DLL identity with identical physical source/reference/compiler inputs.

selection: Require exactly one generator from each expected11.0.0 package; retain the standard Logging.Abstractions LoggerMessage generator, remove only the telemetry logging replacement for the current Tenant host. Metrics and unrelated generators, runtime/reference packages remain. Applied before sealing and inherited by SDK preparation and launch.
